person_specific_rules: The same diagnosis can be mild, episodic, severe, progressive, stable or profoundly disabling in different people.
The same life event can feel traumatic, relieving, mixed, manageable or life-changing depending on context.
Compare with the person's own baseline and priorities.
Preserve autonomy and ask which supports are wanted.
Record strengths and retained abilities as carefully as losses and limitations.
